title: Common programming corpus chunk-size benchmark
objective: Measure the effect of target chunk size on retrieval quality while holding corpus, minimum size, overlap, embedding, retrieval, generation, and evaluation inputs constant.

metrics.name: ndcgAtK
metrics.description: Rewards relevant evidence appearing early while crediting each expected evidence target once.

metrics.name: recallAtK
metrics.description: Measures how many expected evidence targets are retrieved.

metrics.name: precisionAtK
metrics.description: Measures the share of retrieved chunks matching expected evidence.

metrics.name: mrr
metrics.description: Measures how early the first relevant chunk appears.

metrics.name: chunkCount
metrics.description: Records index growth caused by the chunking choice.

metrics.name: embeddingLatencyMs
metrics.description: Tracks the runtime cost of embedding the resulting index.

metrics.name: noAnswerFalsePositiveRate
metrics.description: Prevents a chunking improvement from hiding worse abstention behavior.
